verdict.rationale: Postman supports internal workspaces for sharing/discovering collections and APIs, an API Network for publishing APIs, and Spec Hub/collection design docs, which together enable an internal catalog-like experience. However, there is no explicit evidence of a dedicated 'developer portal' product or public-facing catalog publishing feature distinct from workspaces. missing for 10: dedicated API portal/catalog publishing feature, evidence of external-facing discovery UI, governance/catalog curation tooling beyond workspace sharing.
